correctness.rationale: Any strict alternating two-cycle must move by one \(-\eta\) step and one \(+\eta\) step, so its two parameter values are \(a\) and \(a-\eta\). Solving the two linear momentum periodicity equations gives exactly the displayed \(m_A,m_B\). Substitution into the two sign inputs yields the open interval \(\beta_1\eta/(1+\beta_2)<a<(1-\beta_1/(1+\beta_2))\eta\), which is nonempty exactly when \(2\beta_1<1+\beta_2\). These equations also prove completeness of all strict alternating two-cycles. Inside a fixed sign sector the Jacobian is triangular with eigenvalues 1 and \(\beta_2\), so the two-step multipliers are 1 and \(\beta_2^2\). Completing the square gives the exact objective floor.
